title: Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers
abstract: arXiv:2611.17052v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited. We introduce a benchmark that injects objective, localisable errors of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at three severity levels into real papers and measures each reviewer's detection rate by error type and severity, together with its false-positive rate on clean copies. We also present Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citation-backed claims by retrieving the cited papers, mathematics with computer algebra, and numerical claims with executed code. We apply the benchmark to two corpora of 15 recent arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in machine learning (ML), injecting a total of 357 errors, and evaluate twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available reviewers, and Skepthical. translated_title: 审计AI同行评审者：基于真实科学论文的基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的同行评审目前已投入生产规模使用，但其评估仍然有限。我们引入了一个基准测试，将四类可客观定位的错误（一般性问题、数学、数值计算、引用）以三种严重程度注入真实论文中，并测量每个评审者按错误类型和严重程度划分的检测率，以及其在干净副本上的误报率。我们还提出了Skepthical，一个多智能体评审系统，它通过检索被引论文来验证引用支持的声明，用计算机代数系统验证数学推导，并通过执行代码来验证数值声明。我们将该基准应用于两个各包含15篇近期arXiv预印本的语料库，分别来自天体物理学和机器学习（ML）领域，共注入357个错误，并评估了十二个评审系统：六个单一LLM评审者、两个Claude Code配置、三个公开可用的评审者以及Skepthical。模型的选择对检测率的影响最大。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个通过向真实科学论文注入四类不同严重程度的客观错误来系统审计AI同行评审系统检测能力的基准测试，并推出了结合文献检索、计算机代数和代码执行验证的多智能体评审系统Skepthical。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a benchmark that audits AI peer reviewers by injecting objective errors of four types and three severity levels into real scientific papers, and presents Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citations, mathematics, and numerical claims through retrieval, computer algebra, and executed code.
